question: What class of attainments is being grouped together here as a single enumerated set of results?
premises: Earth-measure and sky-going are listed as attainments.
Subjugation and attraction are added by connectives to the same list.
The enumeration uses connectives to mark a cluster rather than alternatives.
inference: Earth-measure, sky-going, subjugation, and attraction form one enumerated cluster of attainments.
uncertainties: Relative priority among these attainments is not specified by this verse.
plain_english: Earth-measure, sky-going, and subjugation and attraction likewise.
